verses.text: For di third year of Hoshea, Elah pikin, king of Israel, Hezekiah, Ahaz pikin, king of Judah, begin to rule.
E be 25 years old as e begin to rule, and e rule 29 years for Jerusalem. Im mama name na Abi, Zechariah pikin.
E do wetin good for di Lord eyes, according to all wey im papa David do.

E remove di high places, break di pillars and cut down di Asherah pole. E break to pieces di bronze snake wey Moses make, because till dat day Israel pikin dem dey burn incense to am, and dem call am Nehushtan.
E trust di Lord, di God of Israel, so tay nobody like am dey among all di kings of Judah after am, or among dem wey dey before am.
Because e hold on to di Lord. E no turn away from following am, but e keep im commands, wey di Lord command Moses.
Di Lord dey with am. Anywhere e go, e prosper. E rebel against di king of Assyria and no serve am.
E strike di Philistines reach Gaza and im borders, from di watchtower reach di strong city.
For di fourth year of King Hezekiah, wey be di seventh year of Hoshea, Elah pikin, king of Israel, Shalmaneser king of Assyria come up against Samaria and surround am.
For di end of three years dem take am. For di sixth year of Hezekiah, wey be di ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel, dem take Samaria.
Di king of Assyria carry Israel go Assyria as prisoners and put dem for Halah, and for Habor, di river of Gozan, and for di cities of di Medes,
because dem no obey di voice of di Lord dem God, but dem break im covenant, even all wey Moses di servant of di Lord command. Dem no hear am and dem no do am.
For di 14th year of King Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyria come up against all di strong cities of Judah and take dem.

Hezekiah king of Judah send to di king of Assyria for Lachish say, “I don do wrong. Turn back from me. Wetin you put on me, I go pay am.” Di king of Assyria demand from Hezekiah king of Judah 300 talents of silver and 30 talents of gold.
Hezekiah give am all di silver wey dem find for di Lord house and for di treasures of di king house.
For dat time Hezekiah cut off di gold from di doors of di Lord temple, and from di pillars wey Hezekiah king of Judah don cover with gold, and give am to di king of Assyria.

Di king of Assyria send Tartan, Rabsaris and Rabshakeh from Lachish to King Hezekiah with big army for Jerusalem. Dem go up and come Jerusalem, and dem stand by di channel of di upper pool, wey dey di road of di launderer field.
As dem call to di king, Eliakim, Hilkiah pikin, wey dey over di house, and Shebna di secretary, and Joah, Asaph pikin, di recorder, come out to dem.
Rabshakeh talk to dem say, “Tell Hezekiah say, ‘Dis na wetin di great king, di king of Assyria, talk: “Wetin be dis confidence wey you dey trust?
You dey talk, but na only empty words, say you get counsel and strength for war. Now who you dey trust, say you don rebel against me?
Now look, you dey trust for dis broken reed staff, Egypt, wey if man lean on am, e go enter im hand and pierce am. Na so Pharaoh king of Egypt be to all wey trust am.

But if una talk to me say, ‘We trust di Lord our God,’ no be im high places and im altars Hezekiah don remove, and e don talk to Judah and Jerusalem say, ‘Una go worship before dis altar for Jerusalem’?”’
Now come, make bargain with my oga di king of Assyria, and I go give you 2,000 horses, if you fit put riders on dem.
How you go turn back even one captain among di least of my oga servants, and put your trust for Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
Now I don come up without di Lord against dis place to destroy am? Di Lord talk to me say, ‘Go up against dis land and destroy am.’”

Den Eliakim, Hilkiah pikin, and Shebna and Joah talk to Rabshakeh say, “Make you talk to your servants for Syrian language, because we understand am. No talk to us for Jews language for di ears of di people wey dey for di wall.”
But Rabshakeh talk to dem say, “My oga send me to your oga and to you to talk dis words? E no send me to di men wey dey sit for di wall, wey go eat dem own dung and drink dem own urine with una?”
Den Rabshakeh stand and cry with loud voice for Jews language and talk say, “Hear di word of di great king, di king of Assyria.
Dis na wetin di king talk: ‘No make Hezekiah deceive una, because e no go fit save una from my hand.
No make Hezekiah make una trust di Lord, say, “Di Lord go save us for sure, and dem no go give dis city into di hand of di king of Assyria.”

No listen to Hezekiah, because dis na wetin di king of Assyria talk: “Make peace with me and come out to me, and every man go eat from im own vine and from im own fig tree, and drink water from im own well,

until I come and carry una go land like una own land, land of grain and new wine, land of bread and vineyards, land of olive oil and honey, so that una go live and no die.” No listen to Hezekiah when e deceive una say, “Di Lord go save us.”
Any of di gods of di nations don save im land from di hand of di king of Assyria?
Wia di gods of Hamath and Arpad dey? Wia di gods of Sepharvaim, Hena and Ivvah dey? Dem don save Samaria from my hand?
Who among all di gods of di lands don save dem land from my hand, so that di Lord go save Jerusalem from my hand?’”
But di people keep quiet and no answer am even one word, because di king command say, “No answer am.”
Den Eliakim, Hilkiah pikin, wey dey over di house, and Shebna di secretary, and Joah, Asaph pikin, di recorder, come to Hezekiah with dem clothes torn and tell am di words of Rabshakeh.
E happen say as King Hezekiah hear am, e tear im clothes, cover imself with sackcloth and enter di Lord house.
E send Eliakim, wey dey over di house, and Shebna di secretary, and di elders of di priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah di prophet, Amoz pikin.
Dem talk to am say, “Dis na wetin Hezekiah talk: ‘Dis day na day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of shame, because pikin don reach di time to born, but no strength dey to deliver.

Maybe di Lord your God go hear all di words of Rabshakeh, wey im oga di king of Assyria send to mock di living God, and go rebuke di words wey di Lord your God don hear. So lift up prayer for di remnant wey still dey.’”
So di servants of King Hezekiah come to Isaiah.
Isaiah talk to dem say, “Tell your oga say, ‘Dis na wetin di Lord talk: “No fear because of di words wey you don hear, wey di servants of di king of Assyria use blaspheme me.
Look, I go put spirit inside am, and e go hear rumor and return to im own land. I go make am fall by sword for im own land.”’”
So Rabshakeh return and find di king of Assyria dey fight against Libnah, because e don hear say e don leave Lachish.
As e hear about Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, “Look, e don come out to fight against you,” e send messengers again to Hezekiah say,
“Dis na wetin una go talk to Hezekiah king of Judah say, ‘No make your God wey you dey trust deceive you, say, “Dem no go give Jerusalem into di hand of di king of Assyria.”
Look, you don hear wetin di kings of Assyria don do to all di lands, as dem destroy dem completely. You go dey saved?
Di gods of di nations wey my papa dem destroy don save dem, Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and di people of Eden wey dey Tel Assar?
Wia di king of Hamath dey, and di king of Arpad, and di king of di city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah?’”
Hezekiah receive di letter from di hand of di messengers and read am. Hezekiah go up to di Lord house and spread am before di Lord.
Hezekiah pray before di Lord and talk say, “Di Lord, di God of Israel, wey dey sit above di cherubim, na only you be God of all di kingdoms of di earth. You make heaven and earth.
Di Lord, bend your ear and hear. Di Lord, open your eyes and see. Hear di words of Sennacherib, wey e send to mock di living God.
Di Lord, na true say di kings of Assyria don destroy di nations and dem lands,
and don throw dem gods into fire, because dem no be gods, but di work of men hands, wood and stone. So dem don destroy dem.
Now, di Lord our God, I beg, save us from im hand, so that all di kingdoms of di earth go know say you, di Lord, na only you be God.”
Isaiah, Amoz pikin, send to Hezekiah say, “Dis na wetin di Lord, di God of Israel, talk: ‘Wetin you pray to me about Sennacherib king of Assyria, I don hear am.’
Dis na di word wey di Lord don talk against am: ‘Di virgin daughter of Zion don despise you and laugh you for scorn. Di daughter of Jerusalem don shake im head at you.
Who you don mock and blaspheme? Against who you don raise your voice and lift your eyes up high? Against di Holy One of Israel!

By your messengers you don mock di Lord, and don talk say, “With di plenty of my chariots I don go up di height of di mountains, to di far parts of Lebanon. I go cut down di tall cedars and di best cypress trees, and I go enter im farthest lodging place, di forest of im fruitful field.
I don dig and drink strange waters, and with di sole of my feet I don dry up all di rivers of Egypt.”
You no hear say I do am long ago, I plan am from ancient times? Now I don make am happen, say you go turn strong cities to heaps of ruins.
So dem wey dey inside no get power. Dem dey shake and ashamed. Dem be like grass for di field, like green plant, like grass for di roof, and like grain wey burn before e grow.
But I know your sitting down, and your going out, and your coming in, and your rage against me.
Because of your rage against me, and because your pride don reach my ears, I go put my hook for your nose and my bridle for your lips, and I go turn you back by di way wey you take come.’
Dis go be sign to you: dis year una go eat wetin grow on im own, and for di second year wetin spring from am. Den for di third year, plant and harvest, plant vineyards and eat dem fruit.
Di remnant wey escape of Judah house go take root again downward and bear fruit upward.
Because from Jerusalem one remnant go go out, and from Mount Zion di ones wey escape. Di zeal of di Lord of Armies go do dis.
So dis na wetin di Lord talk about di king of Assyria: ‘E no go enter dis city, or shoot arrow there, or come before am with shield, or build siege ramp against am.
By di way wey e come, by di same way e go return, and e no go enter dis city,’ na so di Lord talk.
‘Because I go defend dis city to save am, for my own sake and for di sake of David my servant.’”
E happen for dat night say di angel of di Lord go out and strike 185,000 for di camp of di Assyrians. As people wake up early for morning, look, all of dem na dead bodies.
So Sennacherib king of Assyria leave and go back, and dey stay for Nineveh.
E happen as e dey worship for di house of Nisroch im god, say Adrammelech and Sharezer im sons strike am with sword. Dem escape go Ararat land. Esar Haddon im pikin rule for im place.

For dem days Hezekiah dey sick till e dey near death. Isaiah di prophet, Amoz pikin, come to am and talk to am say, “Dis na wetin di Lord talk: ‘Put your house in order, because you go die, and you no go live.’”
Den e turn im face to di wall and pray to di Lord say,
“Di Lord, I beg, remember now how I don waka before you with faithfulness and with perfect heart, and don do wetin good for your eyes.” Hezekiah cry well well.
E happen say before Isaiah don go out of di middle court, di word of di Lord come to am say,

“Turn back, and tell Hezekiah di leader of my people say, ‘Dis na wetin di Lord, di God of David your papa, talk: “I don hear your prayer. I don see your tears. Look, I go heal you. For di third day you go go up to di Lord house.
I go add 15 years to your days. I go save you and dis city from di hand of di king of Assyria, and I go defend dis city for my own sake and for di sake of my servant David.”’”
Isaiah talk say, “Take lump of figs.” Dem take am and put am on di boil, and e recover.
Hezekiah talk to Isaiah say, “Wetin be di sign say di Lord go heal me, and say I go go up to di Lord house di third day?”
Isaiah talk say, “Dis na di sign to you from di Lord, say di Lord go do di thing wey e don talk: make di shadow go forward ten steps, or go back ten steps?”
Hezekiah answer say, “E easy for di shadow to go down ten steps. No, but make di shadow go back ten steps.”
Isaiah di prophet cry to di Lord, and e make di shadow go back ten steps, wey e don go down for di steps of Ahaz.
For dat time Merodach Baladan, Baladan pikin, king of Babylon, send letters and gift to Hezekiah, because e hear say Hezekiah don sick.

Hezekiah listen to dem and show dem all im treasure house, di silver, and di gold, and di spices, and di precious oil, and im armory, and all wey dem find for im treasures. Nothing dey for im house or for all im kingdom wey Hezekiah no show dem.
Den Isaiah di prophet come to King Hezekiah and talk to am say, “Wetin dis men talk? Wia dem come from to you?” Hezekiah talk say, “Dem come from far country, from Babylon.”
E talk say, “Wetin dem see for your house?” Hezekiah answer say, “All wey dey my house, dem don see am. Nothing dey among my treasures wey I no show dem.”
Isaiah talk to Hezekiah say, “Hear di word of di Lord.
‘Look, di days dey come wey everything wey dey your house, and wey your papa dem don store up till today, dem go carry go Babylon. Nothing go remain,’ na so di Lord talk.
‘Dem go take some of your pikin dem wey go come from you, wey you go born, and dem go be eunuchs for di palace of di king of Babylon.’”
Hezekiah talk to Isaiah say, “Di word of di Lord wey you don talk good.” E talk say, “If peace and truth go dey for my days, e no good?”
Di rest of wetin Hezekiah do, and all im power, and how e make di pool and di channel and bring water inside di city, dem no write dem for di book of di chronicles of di kings of Judah?
Hezekiah die join im papa dem, and im pikin Manasseh rule for im place.
Manasseh be 12 years old as e begin to rule, and e rule 55 years for Jerusalem. Im mama name na Hephzibah.
E do wetin bad for di Lord eyes, after di disgusting ways of di nations wey di Lord drive out before Israel pikin dem.
E rebuild di high places wey im papa Hezekiah don destroy. E set up altars for Baal and make Asherah pole, as Ahab king of Israel do, and e worship all di army of heaven and serve dem.
E build altars for di Lord house, wey di Lord talk about say, “For Jerusalem I go put my name.”
E build altars for all di army of heaven for di two courts of di Lord house.
E make im pikin pass through fire, use witchcraft and fortune telling, and deal with mediums and wizards. E do plenty evil for di Lord eyes, to make am vex.

E set di carved image of Asherah wey e make for di house, about wey di Lord talk to David and to Solomon im pikin say, “For dis house and for Jerusalem, wey I don choose from all di tribes of Israel, I go put my name forever.
I no go again make di feet of Israel wander from di land wey I give dem papa dem, if only dem go take care to do all wey I command dem, and all di law wey my servant Moses command dem.”
But dem no listen, and Manasseh lead dem go astray to do more evil pass di nations wey di Lord destroy before Israel pikin dem.
Di Lord talk by im servants di prophets say,
“Because Manasseh king of Judah don do dis disgusting things, and don do wickedness pass all wey di Amorites do wey dey before am, and don make Judah sin with im idols too,
so dis na wetin di Lord, di God of Israel, talk: ‘Look, I dey bring evil on Jerusalem and Judah, so tay whoever hear am, two ears of am go ring.
I go stretch over Jerusalem di measuring line of Samaria and di plumb line of Ahab house, and I go wipe Jerusalem as man dey wipe dish, wipe am and turn am upside down.
I go throw away di remnant of my inheritance and give dem into di hand of dem enemies, and dem go become prey and plunder to all dem enemies,
because dem don do wetin bad for my eyes and don make me vex, from di day wey dem papa dem come out of Egypt, even till today.’”
Manasseh shed plenty innocent blood too, until e fill Jerusalem from one end to di other end, apart from im sin wey e use make Judah sin, to do wetin bad for di Lord eyes.
Di rest of wetin Manasseh do, and all wey e do, and im sin wey e sin, dem no write dem for di book of di chronicles of di kings of Judah?
Manasseh die join im papa dem, and dem bury am for di garden of im own house, di garden of Uzza, and im pikin Amon rule for im place.
Amon be 22 years old as e begin to rule, and e rule two years for Jerusalem. Im mama name na Meshullemeth, Haruz pikin, from Jotbah.
E do wetin bad for di Lord eyes, as im papa Manasseh do.
E waka for all di way wey im papa waka, and serve di idols wey im papa serve, and worship dem.
E leave di Lord, di God of im papa dem, and no waka for di way of di Lord.
Di servants of Amon make plot against am and kill di king for im own house.
But di people of di land strike all wey make plot against King Amon, and di people of di land make Josiah im pikin king for im place.
Di rest of wetin Amon do, dem no write dem for di book of di chronicles of di kings of Judah?
Dem bury am for im grave for di garden of Uzza, and im pikin Josiah rule for im place.
Josiah be eight years old as e begin to rule, and e rule 31 years for Jerusalem. Im mama name na Jedidah, Adaiah pikin, from Bozkath.
E do wetin good for di Lord eyes, and e waka for all di way of David im papa, and e no turn aside to di right or to di left.
E happen for di 18th year of King Josiah say di king send Shaphan, Azaliah pikin, Meshullam pikin, di secretary, to di Lord house, say,
“Go up to Hilkiah di high priest, so that e go count di money wey dem bring come di Lord house, wey di guards of di door don gather from di people.
Make dem give am into di hand of di workmen wey dey over di Lord house, and make dem give am to di workmen wey dey di Lord house, to repair wetin don break for di house,
to di carpenters, and builders, and masons, and to buy wood and cut stone to repair di house.
But dem no go ask dem to account for di money wey dem give into dem hand, because dem dey work with faithfulness.”
Hilkiah di high priest talk to Shaphan di secretary say, “I don find di book of di law for di Lord house.” Hilkiah give di book to Shaphan, and e read am.

Shaphan di secretary come to di king and bring di king word back say, “Your servants don pour out di money wey dem find for di house and don give am into di hand of di workmen wey dey over di Lord house.”
Shaphan di secretary tell di king say, “Hilkiah di priest don give me one book.” Shaphan read am before di king.
E happen say as di king hear di words of di book of di law, e tear im clothes.
Di king command Hilkiah di priest, and Ahikam, Shaphan pikin, and Achbor, Micaiah pikin, and Shaphan di secretary, and Asaiah di king servant, say,

“Go ask di Lord for me, and for di people, and for all Judah, about di words of dis book wey dem don find, because di anger of di Lord wey don burn against us big, because our papa dem no listen to di words of dis book, to do all wey dem write about us.”

So Hilkiah di priest, and Ahikam, and Achbor, and Shaphan, and Asaiah go to Huldah di prophetess, di wife of Shallum, Tikvah pikin, Harhas pikin, wey keep di wardrobe. Now e dey stay for Jerusalem for di second quarter, and dem talk with am.
E talk to dem say, “Dis na wetin di Lord, di God of Israel, talk: ‘Tell di man wey send una to me,
“Dis na wetin di Lord talk: ‘Look, I go bring evil on dis place and on im people, even all di words of di book wey di king of Judah don read.
Because dem don leave me and don burn incense to other gods, to make me vex with all di work of dem hands, my anger go burn against dis place and e no go quench.’”
But to di king of Judah wey send una to ask di Lord, dis na wetin una go tell am: ‘Dis na wetin di Lord, di God of Israel, talk: “About di words wey you don hear,

because your heart soft and you don humble yourself before di Lord, as you hear wetin I talk against dis place and against im people, say dem go become desolation and curse, and you tear your clothes and cry before me, I don hear you,” na so di Lord talk.
“So look, I go gather you to your papa dem, and you go gather to your grave in peace, and your eyes no go see all di evil wey I go bring on dis place.”’” Dem bring di king word back.
Di king send, and dem gather all di elders of Judah and of Jerusalem to am.

Di king go up to di Lord house, and all di men of Judah and all di people wey dey stay for Jerusalem with am, and di priests, and di prophets, and all di people, small and big. E read for dem ears all di words of di book of di covenant wey dem find for di Lord house.

Di king stand by di pillar and make covenant before di Lord, to waka after di Lord, and to keep im commands, and im warnings, and im laws with all im heart and all im soul, to do di words of dis covenant wey dem write for dis book. All di people stand for di covenant.

Di king command Hilkiah di high priest, and di priests of di second order, and di guards of di door, to bring out of di Lord temple all di vessels wey dem make for Baal, and for Asherah, and for all di army of heaven. E burn dem outside Jerusalem for di fields of Kidron, and carry dem ashes go Bethel.

E remove di idol priests wey di kings of Judah don appoint to burn incense for di high places for di cities of Judah and for di places round Jerusalem, and dem wey burn incense to Baal, to di sun, to di moon, to di planets and to all di army of heaven.
E bring out di Asherah pole from di Lord house, outside Jerusalem, to Kidron brook, and burn am for Kidron brook, grind am to powder and throw im powder for di graves of di common people.
E break down di houses of di male prostitutes wey dey di Lord house, wia di women dey weave hangings for Asherah.

E bring all di priests from di cities of Judah, and make di high places wey di priests burn incense unclean, from Geba reach Beersheba. E break down di high places of di gates wey dey di entrance of di gate of Joshua di governor of di city, wey dey left of di gate of di city.
Still, di priests of di high places no come up to di Lord altar for Jerusalem, but dem eat unleavened bread among dem brothers.
E make Topheth, wey dey di valley of di pikin dem of Hinnom, unclean, so that nobody go make im pikin or im daughter pass through fire to Molech.
E remove di horses wey di kings of Judah give to di sun, from di entrance of di Lord house, by di room of Nathan Melech di officer, wey dey di precincts, and e burn di chariots of di sun with fire.

Di altars wey dey di roof of di upper room of Ahaz, wey di kings of Judah make, and di altars wey Manasseh make for di two courts of di Lord house, di king break dem down and smash dem from dem place, and throw dem dust for Kidron brook.

Di high places wey dey before Jerusalem, wey dey di right side of di Mount of Corruption, wey Solomon king of Israel build for Ashtoreth di disgusting goddess of di Sidonians, and for Chemosh di disgusting god of Moab, and for Milcom di disgusting god of di Ammonites, di king make dem unclean.
E break di pillars to pieces, cut down di Asherah poles, and fill dem places with men bones.

Again di altar wey dey Bethel, di high place wey Jeroboam, Nebat pikin, wey make Israel sin, don make, even dat altar and di high place e break down, and e burn di high place, grind am to powder and burn di Asherah pole.

As Josiah turn, e see di graves wey dey there for di mountain, and e send and take di bones from di graves and burn dem on di altar and make am unclean, as di word of di Lord wey di man of God cry out, wey cry out dis things.
Den e talk say, “Wetin be dis monument wey I see?” Di men of di city tell am say, “Na di grave of di man of God wey come from Judah and cry out dis things wey you don do against di altar of Bethel.”
E talk say, “Leave am alone. Make nobody move im bones.” So dem leave im bones alone, with di bones of di prophet wey come from Samaria.
Josiah remove all di houses of di high places wey dey di cities of Samaria too, wey di kings of Israel don make to make di Lord vex, and e do to dem like all di works wey e do for Bethel.
E kill all di priests of di high places wey dey there on di altars, and burn men bones on dem. Den e return to Jerusalem.
Di king command all di people say, “Keep di Passover to di Lord una God, as dem write am for dis book of di covenant.”
For sure dem no keep dat kind Passover from di days of di judges wey judge Israel, or for all di days of di kings of Israel or di kings of Judah,
but for di 18th year of King Josiah, dem keep dis Passover to di Lord for Jerusalem.

Josiah remove di mediums, di wizards, di household gods, di idols, and all di disgusting things wey dem see for Judah land and for Jerusalem, so that e go confirm di words of di law wey dem write for di book wey Hilkiah di priest find for di Lord house.
Before am no king dey like am, wey turn to di Lord with all im heart, and with all im soul, and with all im might, according to all di law of Moses. After am nobody rise like am.
Still di Lord no turn from di fierceness of im great anger, wey burn against Judah, because of all di provocations wey Manasseh provoke am.
Di Lord talk say, “I go remove Judah too from my sight, as I don remove Israel, and I go reject dis city wey I choose, Jerusalem, and di house wey I talk about say, ‘My name go dey there.’”
Di rest of wetin Josiah do, and all wey e do, dem no write dem for di book of di chronicles of di kings of Judah?
For im days Pharaoh Necoh king of Egypt go up against di king of Assyria to di river Euphrates. King Josiah go against am, and Pharaoh Necoh kill am for Megiddo as e see am.
Im servants carry am dead for chariot from Megiddo, bring am to Jerusalem and bury am for im own grave. Di people of di land take Jehoahaz, Josiah pikin, anoint am and make am king for im papa place.
Jehoahaz be 23 years old as e begin to rule, and e rule three months for Jerusalem. Im mama name na Hamutal, Jeremiah pikin, from Libnah.
E do wetin bad for di Lord eyes, according to all wey im papa dem do.
Pharaoh Necoh put am for bonds for Riblah for Hamath land, so that e no go rule for Jerusalem, and e put di land under tribute of 100 talents of silver and one talent of gold.
Pharaoh Necoh make Eliakim, Josiah pikin, king for im papa Josiah place, and change im name to Jehoiakim. But e take Jehoahaz away, and e come Egypt and die there.

Jehoiakim give di silver and di gold to Pharaoh, but e tax di land to give di money according to Pharaoh command. E collect di silver and di gold from di people of di land, from every man according to im tax, to give to Pharaoh Necoh.
Jehoiakim be 25 years old as e begin to rule, and e rule 11 years for Jerusalem. Im mama name na Zebidah, Pedaiah pikin, from Rumah.
E do wetin bad for di Lord eyes, according to all wey im papa dem do.
For im days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon come up, and Jehoiakim become im servant three years. Den e turn and rebel against am.

Di Lord send against am bands of Chaldeans, and bands of Syrians, and bands of Moabites, and bands of Ammon pikin dem, and send dem against Judah to destroy am, as di word of di Lord wey e talk by im servants di prophets.
For sure na by di command of di Lord e come on Judah, to remove dem from im sight, because of di sins of Manasseh, according to all wey e do,
and also because of di innocent blood wey e shed, because e fill Jerusalem with innocent blood, and di Lord no wan forgive.
Di rest of wetin Jehoiakim do, and all wey e do, dem no write dem for di book of di chronicles of di kings of Judah?
So Jehoiakim die join im papa dem, and im pikin Jehoiachin rule for im place.
Di king of Egypt no come out of im land again, because di king of Babylon don take all wey belong to di king of Egypt, from di river of Egypt reach di river Euphrates.
Jehoiachin be 18 years old as e begin to rule, and e rule three months for Jerusalem. Im mama name na Nehushta, Elnathan pikin, from Jerusalem.
E do wetin bad for di Lord eyes, according to all wey im papa do.
For dat time di servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon come up to Jerusalem, and dem surround di city.
Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon come to di city as im servants dey surround am.
Jehoiachin king of Judah go out to di king of Babylon, e and im mama, and im servants, and im princes, and im officers. Di king of Babylon take am for di eighth year of im rule.

E carry out from there all di treasures of di Lord house and di treasures of di king house, and cut into pieces all di vessels of gold wey Solomon king of Israel make for di Lord temple, as di Lord talk.
E carry away all Jerusalem, and all di princes, and all di mighty men of valor, 10,000 prisoners, and all di craftsmen and di smiths. Nobody remain, except di poorest people of di land.
E carry Jehoiachin go Babylon, and di king mama, and di king wives, and im officers, and di mighty men of di land, e carry dem as prisoners from Jerusalem go Babylon.
All di men of valor, 7,000, and di craftsmen and di smiths, 1,000, all of dem strong and fit for war, di king of Babylon bring dem as prisoners to Babylon.
Di king of Babylon make Mattaniah, im uncle, king for im place, and change im name to Zedekiah.
Zedekiah be 21 years old as e begin to rule, and e rule 11 years for Jerusalem. Im mama name na Hamutal, Jeremiah pikin, from Libnah.
E do wetin bad for di Lord eyes, according to all wey Jehoiakim do.
Because through di anger of di Lord e come to pass for Jerusalem and Judah, until e don throw dem out from im presence. Zedekiah rebel against di king of Babylon.

For di ninth year of im rule, for di tenth month, for di tenth day of di month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon come, e and all im army, against Jerusalem and camp against am. Dem build siege works round am.
So di city dey under siege till di 11th year of King Zedekiah.
For di ninth day of di fourth month, di hunger dey so bad for di city say no food dey for di people of di land.

Den dem break into di city, and all di men of war run for night by di way of di gate between di two walls, wey dey by di king garden, as di Chaldeans dey round di city. Di king go by di way of di Arabah.
But di army of di Chaldeans chase di king and catch am for di plains of Jericho, and all im army scatter from am.
Dem catch di king and bring am up to di king of Babylon for Riblah, and dem pass judgment on am.
Dem kill Zedekiah sons before im eyes, and dem put out Zedekiah eyes, bind am with bronze chains and carry am go Babylon.
For di fifth month, for di seventh day of di month, wey be di 19th year of King Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan, captain of di guard, servant of di king of Babylon, come to Jerusalem.
E burn di Lord house, and di king house, and all di houses of Jerusalem. Every big house e burn with fire.
All di army of di Chaldeans wey dey with di captain of di guard break down di walls of Jerusalem round.
Di rest of di people wey remain for di city, and di ones wey don fall away to di king of Babylon, and di rest of di multitude, Nebuzaradan di captain of di guard carry go as prisoners.
But di captain of di guard leave some of di poorest of di land to be vine dressers and farmers.
Di bronze pillars wey dey di Lord house, and di bases, and di bronze sea wey dey di Lord house, di Chaldeans break am to pieces and carry di bronze go Babylon.
Dem take away di pots, and di shovels, and di snuffers, and di spoons, and all di bronze vessels wey dem dey use for service.
Di fire pans, and di basins, wetin na gold, di gold, and wetin na silver, di silver, di captain of di guard take dem away.
Di two pillars, di one sea, and di bases wey Solomon make for di Lord house, di bronze of all dis vessels no get weight.

Di height of one pillar na 18 cubits, and di capital on am na bronze, and di height of di capital na three cubits, with network and pomegranates round di capital, all bronze. Di second pillar get di same, with network.
Di captain of di guard take Seraiah di chief priest, and Zephaniah di second priest, and di three guards of di door.

From di city e take one officer wey dey over di men of war, and five men of dem wey dey see di king face, wey dem find for di city, and di scribe of di captain of di army wey dey gather di people of di land, and 60 men of di people of di land wey dem find for di city.
Nebuzaradan di captain of di guard take dem and bring dem to di king of Babylon for Riblah.
Di king of Babylon strike dem and kill dem for Riblah for Hamath land. So Judah go away as prisoners from dem land.
As for di people wey remain for Judah land, wey Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon leave, e make Gedaliah, Ahikam pikin, Shaphan pikin, governor over dem.

As all di captains of di armies, dem and dem men, hear say di king of Babylon don make Gedaliah governor, dem come to Gedaliah for Mizpah, Ishmael, Nethaniah pikin, and Johanan, Kareah pikin, and Seraiah, Tanhumeth pikin, di Netophathite, and Jaazaniah, di son of di Maacathite, dem and dem men.
Gedaliah swear to dem and to dem men and talk to dem say, “No fear to be servants of di Chaldeans. Stay for di land and serve di king of Babylon, and e go well with una.”

But e happen for di seventh month say Ishmael, Nethaniah pikin, Elishama pikin, of di royal family, come with ten men and strike Gedaliah, and e die, and di Jews and di Chaldeans wey dey with am for Mizpah.
All di people, small and big, and di captains of di armies, stand up and come to Egypt, because dem fear di Chaldeans.

E happen for di 37th year of di captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, for di 12th month, for di 27th day of di month, Evil Merodach king of Babylon, for di year wey e begin to rule, lift up di head of Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison.
E talk kindly to am and set im throne above di thrones of di kings wey dey with am for Babylon.
E change im prison clothes, and Jehoiachin eat bread before am regularly all di days of im life.
For im allowance, di king give am regular allowance every day, all di days of im life.
